subtasks.title: Close Scout Bird's Eye admin-mode fetch leak (App.vue gate + JSON-404 route backstop + tests)
subtasks.approach: 1) resources/js/clarity-scout/App.vue: in the watch(() => auth.isAuthenticated, ..., {immediate:true}) handler, gate shift.fetchStatus() + notifications.fetch() on !mapStore.adminMode (mirror the existing !mapStore.adminMode convention in MapShell.vue:12 / ScannerMap.vue:279). Do not change driver behavior. 2) routes/web.php: inside the scout/org-map `Route::prefix('api')->group(...)` block, AFTER all explicit admin api routes and BEFORE the group's `{any?}` SPA view catch-all, register `Route::get('{any}', fn () => response()->json(['message' => 'Not Found.'], 404))->where('any', '.*');` so any unmatched admin-api path returns JSON instead of the HTML shell. Verify exact placement: it must NOT shadow the real explicit routes and must be matched before the SPA `{any?}` view. 3) Tests in tests/Feature/Http/Controllers/Api/ClarityScoutBirdsEyeControllerTest.php mirroring sibling driver_paths tests. 4) npm run build and commit the rebuilt public/build assets (tracked in this repo).
subtasks.intended_diffs: App.vue: wrap the two fetch calls in `if (!mapStore.adminMode) { ... }` (confirm mapStore is already imported in App.vue; prep grounding shows adminMode used elsewhere in the file). routes/web.php: one new Route::get line inside the api group. Test file: 3 new test methods.
tests: GET /scout/org-map/api/shift/status as an authed Scout admin returns JSON 404 (Content-Type application/json, status 404), NOT the clarity-scout-birds-eye HTML view — pins the JSON-404 backstop and reproduces the exact bug mechanism.

A legitimate SPA deep link under /scout/org-map (e.g. /scout/org-map/some-client-route with no /api prefix) STILL returns the Blade shell (assertSee the app root) — proves the JSON-404 fallback does not shadow Vue Router deep links.
GET /scout/org-map/api/map/driver-positions as an authed Scout admin returns 200 JSON with the expected shape (previously zero coverage for driverPositions).

excluded_sites.reason: Already gated off admin mode on main by DEV-2164 (MapShell !adminMode) + DEV-2179 — the literal ticket symptom's sink; nothing to change.
Latent query-param-only leaks (UI triggers already hidden in admin mode). Dalton (Q3) chose NOT to add an explicit gate — the new JSON-404 route backstop neutralizes them cleanly. Out of scope.

A genuine unhandled exception there is rendered as JSON by Laravel's default handler (no custom exception override), so it does not cause the HTML fallback this ticket is about. Optional hardening; out of scope (grounded out by deep candidates 2/3).

ac_coverage.AC1 (JSON incl. on error, no HTML fallba: t1 — App.vue gate removes the live leak; JSON-404 route backstop makes it a durable invariant.
ac_coverage.AC2 (underlying server-side error identi: t1 — identified as a client-side routing leak (no server exception); fixed via the gate + backstop. Reframing to be confirmed in QA (Q1).
ac_coverage.AC3 (all-driver positions render): verify-only in QA (Q2) — no code change scoped; escalate to a code fix only if QA shows dots genuinely don't render.

sizing: 3 source files + rebuilt assets, one cohesive concern. Under the >6-file / multi-concern split threshold. Single-node DAG → Phase 4 single-node fast path (no worktree fan-out).
clickhouse_note: data_impact.ch_tables = [clarity.sc_positions] AND ClarityScoutBirdsEyeControllerTest is gated by RequiresClickhouse (whole class skipped unless CLICKHOUSE_DRIVER=clickhouse). Phase 4 MUST ensure the Docker CH env (QA_PROVISION_CH=yes) so the new tests actually run — otherwise they silently skip.
notes: public/build is committed — the App.vue change requires `npm run build` + committing rebuilt assets, or the fix won't ship (platform-commits-built-assets).
No JS test runner — the App.vue gate has no automated coverage; it is verified via QA Network tab (no 200 text/html under /scout/org-map/api/*). The route backstop IS PHPUnit-tested.
